title: Update The Rootwell, the town's power beacon
notes: Connect the existing pressure needle to shared city supply. Correct low red band: normal 5–6 green, 8–9 amber, 9–10 red. Face remains 0–10; actual pressure may reach 15 and needle pegs/jitters above 10. Preserve adopted source geometry and record deliberate edit.

catalog_entry.label: The Rootwell, the town's power beacon
catalog_entry.pivot: Ground centre. The octagon has a face toward each compass point and diagonal; the pressure gauge faces south-east, toward the game camera (notice board south, maintenance door east, service panel north-west). Steps 7.5 across the flats, 8.1 across the corners; the finial stands 9.5 high.
catalog_entry.behavior: The centrepiece of Rootward Square v3 at (42, 24); the area document owns its blocks, inspections and lamps. Parts that story may move later are separate nodes with their pivots (story_parts): the needle turns about its local Z (-27 degrees per unit of pressure in Godot, authored at 1.3), the door swings about its hinge (local Y), the valve wheels spin about their axles. Model geometry grants no capability; placements, collision and interactions belong to the area document.

Shared saved pressure drives it, pegs/flutter above 10 and trips the city supply at 15. Source backup, audited normal build, full scripts/test.sh pass and native 1600×1000 / 1280×720 review complete.
